summary_md: **Aleksandar Perisic ([@apsolut](https://x.com/apsolut/status/2115181931788935556))** open-sources **one-shot-multicam**: a single phone selfie stays as camera A, while open-weight models on ComfyUI generate lip-synced B and C angles from his real voice and then auto-cut the edit. The GitHub repo describes it as ComfyUI plus an LTX-2.3 ID LoRA, all open weights.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - apsolut/one-shot-multicam: Multicam from one phone shot — turn a single selfie video into a multi-camera edit with ComfyUI + LTX-2.3 ID LoRA (open weights). #OpenSourceHiggsfield

relevance: A fully local, open-weight agentic video pipeline that turns one shot into a multicam edit.
